provenance.source: KODAK VISION Premier Color Print Film / 2393 datasheet, KODAK Publication No. H-1-2393t (September 1998, CAT 118 6618), page 5 vector charts, digitized from embedded PDF path geometry
provenance.material: motion-picture colour print film on ESTAR base, viewed by projection
provenance.dye_scale: as printed: the component densities of the charted visual neutral, not peak-normalised

sheet_text.lad_note: the LAD patch is printed to a neutral gray of 1.0 visual density (1.00 Equivalent Neutral Density); Status A densities as printed
sheet_text.printing_filtration: KODAK WRATTEN Gelatin Filter No. 2B, KODAK Heat Absorbing Glass, No. 2043

digitization_audit.coordinates: x_px = PyMuPDF page x (crop-box origin; the media box starts 90 pt left of it), y_px = page height minus PyMuPDF y

x_axis.label_sign: bar over the integer digit = negative; the bar is a drawn stroke, read from the drawing

calibration_bracket.alternative: frame edges alone, at their printed end values

characteristic_curves.channel_rule: G = highest right end, R = lowest right end, matching the printed G-above-R letters; B = the curve under the printed leader tip
characteristic_curves.exposure: 1/500 sec Tungsten plus KODAK Heat Absorbing Glass, No. 2043 (plus Series 1700 Filter)

y_axis.label_sign: bar over the integer digit = negative, read from the drawing

calibration_bracket.alternative: frame edges alone, at their printed end values

unattributed_uv_branch.attribution: none printed; assigned to no layer

spectral_sensitivity.grid: 2 nm inside each curve's traced support plus its two traced end points
spectral_sensitivity.definition: sensitivity = reciprocal of exposure (ergs/cm^2) required to produce specified density; density 1.0; effective exposure tungsten 1/50 sec; process ECP-2B

calibration_bracket.alternative: frame edges alone, at their printed end values

spectral_dye_density.curve_rule: visual neutral = highest mean density, above every dye at every wavelength (least clearance 0.0630 D); dyes by peak wavelength
spectral_dye_density.caption_as_printed: Typical densities for a midscale neutral subject and D-min. Process: ECP-2B
spectral_dye_density.caption_note: the frame holds four curves; no D-min curve is drawn

neutral_minus_dye_sum.meaning: visual neutral minus (cyan + magenta + yellow), the density the three drawn dyes do not account for

visual_density_of_visual_neutral.weight: CIE 1931 y-bar times a Planckian source

digitization_audit.not_traced: F010_0061AC diffuse rms granularity chart; the modulation-transfer chart on page index 3 belongs to the MTF tracer
